meta.rule: Wartości wejściowe o największej zgodności w recenzowanej literaturze; impaktor i krater z modeli hydrokodowych i obserwacji; zjawiska dalekiego pola liczone prawami skalowania EIEP (Collins i in. 2005) z jednej energii scenariusza.

parameters.label: Nadciśnienie w 200 km dla scenariusza 18 km / 20 km/s (Collins 2005, Tab. 6)
parameters.notes: Published worked example for 'a reasonable estimate of the scale of the Chicxulub impact event' (18-km stony body, 20 km/s, 45 deg). Back-calculation shows it equals Eq. 54 with ~0.5*E.

Energia wybuchu Hunga Tonga (ekwiwalent TNT, z fal ciśnienia)
parameters.locator: vergoz2022 Abstract (100-200 Mt); wright2022 Main (10-28 EJ total energy, i.e. ~2,400-6,700 Mt); matoza2022 (nuclear-test yield relations give 'unphysically large' yields)
parameters.notes: Different quantities/methods; illustrates why Lamb-wave amplitude cannot simply be scaled with source energy to Chicxulub (~1e5-1e6 times more energetic).

parameters.label: Wykładnik zaniku amplitudy fali Lamba z odległością (r^n)
parameters.method: measured (IMS + barometers, Hunga) and consistent with cylindrical spreading
parameters.locator: Sect. on Lamb wave amplitudes, Fig. 7a
parameters.notes: ~r^-1/2 at intermediate range; constant or slightly increasing beyond ~10,000 km due to focusing on the sphere.

parameters.label: Amplituda fali Lamba (peak-to-peak) w odl. 756 km od Hunga
parameters.notes: Decreases 'logarithmically' with range; scatter >7,500 km from winds and focusing.

parameters.label: Czas dotarcia czoła fali Lamba do antypodów Chicxulub
parameters.notes: ~17.6 h (17.1-18.3 h). Within the 24 h window the Lamb front converges at the antipode and the first antipodal (major-arc) passage begins; no full circuit is completed.

parameters.label: Czas pełnego okrążenia Ziemi przez falę Lamba
parameters.notes: ~35.3 h - outside the 24 h window.

parameters.label: Liczba zarejestrowanych przejść fali Lamba (Hunga Tonga, 6 dni)
parameters.locator: main text ('at least four minor-arc ... (A1,3,5,7) and three major-arc (A2,4,6) passages'; similar to Krakatau 1883)
parameters.notes: Each antipodal passage introduces a 90 deg phase shift (polar phase shift).

parameters.label: Dominujący okres fali Lamba (Hunga Tonga)
parameters.locator: matoza2022 main text (1,700-2,500 s; full band 100-3,300 s); vergoz2022 Abstract (>2000 s)
parameters.notes: About 4x longer than for the largest nuclear test (400-700 s); for Chicxulub the period is unknown (open question).

parameters.label: Impuls ciśnienia fali Lamba na mareografach (Hunga)
parameters.locator: main text (2 hPa at coastal tide gauges; 5 hPa leading pulse at deep-sea tsunameters)

parameters.label: Prędkość fali Lamba (globalna fala ciśnienia przy powierzchni)
parameters.method: measured (Hunga Tonga 2022: barometers, IMS infrasound, satellites)
parameters.locator: matoza2022 main text (group velocity ~315 m/s; ~310 m/s theoretical for 16 km scale height); wright2022 Abstract (318.2+/-6 m/s at surface; 308+/-5 to 319+/-4 m/s in stratosphere, phase speeds); vergoz2022 sect. 2 (nominal 310 m/s)
parameters.notes: Measured for the present atmosphere; speed is set by the lower-atmosphere mean sound speed (temperature) and winds. Applying it to Chicxulub (warmer Maastrichtian atmosphere, extreme source) is an EXTRAPOLATION; a few-K warmer column would raise it by only ~1%.

parameters.label: Wyprzedzenie 'tsunami-zwiastuna' wymuszonego falą Lamba względem zwykłego tsunami (Hunga)
parameters.locator: kubota2022 Abstract ('more than 2 hours earlier'); matoza2022 (tide-gauge onset coincident with ~2 hPa Lamb pulse; 5 hPa at deep-sea gauges)
parameters.notes: Lower bound. Mechanism transferable to Chicxulub (extrapolation): a Lamb-wave-driven sea-level disturbance would run ahead of the impact tsunami at ~315 m/s.

parameters.label: Współczynnik przeszacowania podmuchu przez skalowanie dla E > 1e4 Mt
parameters.notes: Value = middle of 2-5.

parameters.label: Górna granica energii, do której skalowanie podmuchu Collinsa zgadza się z modelami numerycznymi
parameters.method: model comparison stated by collins2005 (Zahnle 1990; Toon et al. 1994)
parameters.notes: 'in good agreement with our simple model in the 1-10000 Mt range; for impact energies greater than this, Equation 44 [sic, = Eq. 54] probably overestimates the blast wave effects by a factor of 2-5'. Chicxulub (~1e8 Mt) is ~4 orders of magnitude above this limit.

parameters.label: Czarny węgiel pochodzący ze skał w miejscu uderzenia
parameters.method: measured PAH/stratigraphy near crater + mass balance (lyons2020)
parameters.notes: Published as 7.5e14-2.5e15 g; value = midpoint of the range (not a published central value). Dispersed globally within a few hours according to the authors.

parameters.label: Masa CO2 wyrzuconego do atmosfery
parameters.locator: artemieva2017: Abstract; pierazzo1998: Abstract; pope1997: Abstract
parameters.notes: 425 ± 160 Gt (Artemieva); 350-3500 Gt depending on impactor size/velocity, ≤40 % increase of end-Cretaceous atmospheric CO2 (Pierazzo 1998); >500 Gt to stratosphere and <1 K greenhouse warming (Pope 1997). Range spans Artemieva lower 1σ (265) to Pierazzo max (3500).

parameters.label: Drobny pył krzemianowy — górna granica rozmiaru
parameters.method: measured grain-size distribution, Tanis K-Pg layer (senel2023)
parameters.notes: See dust_fine_size_min.

parameters.label: Drobny pył krzemianowy — dolna granica rozmiaru
parameters.method: measured grain-size distribution, Tanis K-Pg layer (senel2023)
parameters.notes: Fine fraction ~0.8-8.0 µm 'larger contribution than previously appreciated'. Total dust mass not verified (main text inaccessible).

parameters.label: Czas przebywania drobnego pyłu w atmosferze (model)
parameters.notes: Contributes up to 15 °C global-mean cooling in their simulations.

parameters.label: Skala grubości optycznej pyłu (założenie)
parameters.notes: Założenie: grubość optyczna pyłu rośnie proporcjonalnie do skumulowanego ułamka ejecta wracających do atmosfery (25/55/85 % po 2/8/72 h); skala dobrana tak, by przy 85 % światło spadło do progu fotosyntezy 1 % (τ = ln 100 / 0,85). Chmura pyłu dociera do miejsca z prędkością ejecta.dust_cloud_speed po rozpadzie kurtyny. Synteza: Założenie modelu predykcyjnego projektu (luka w literaturze; zgoda użytkownika 2026-10-04).

parameters.label: Udział wysokoenergetycznych wyrzutów, które wróciły do atmosfery po 2 h
parameters.notes: Deposition concentrated near crater and antipode; atmospheric shock heating in pulses over a few days.

parameters.label: Udział wysokoenergetycznych wyrzutów, które wróciły po 72 h

parameters.method: model assumption: bardeen2017 (land biomass 2 g/cm² burned)
parameters.notes: Assumes global combustion of land biomass of 2 g cm⁻² (air-dried wood energy).

parameters.label: Wysokość, powyżej której gazy uznano za mające skutki globalne
parameters.notes: Criterion used in the hydrocode quantification of climate-active gases ('high enough altitudes (> 25 km) to have global consequences').

parameters.label: Masa pary wodnej wprowadzonej do górnej atmosfery
parameters.notes: Value = lower bound ('over 200 Gt' to stratosphere, Pope 1997); Pierazzo 1998 gives 200-1400 Gt for 10-30 km impactors (upper values for impactors larger than currently favoured).

parameters.label: Czas, w którym światło < 1 % normy (zatrzymanie fotosyntezy)
parameters.locator: bardeen2017: Results, Fig. 2; senel2023: Abstract; tabor2020: Abstract; pope1997: Abstract
parameters.notes: ~2 yr for ≥15,000 Tg soot (Bardeen) or fine dust (Senel); <1 month for 750 Tg soot; Tabor: only soot gives many months below threshold; Pope: ~6 months if the early sulfate pulse was global. Which agent dominates is contested; effect lies beyond the 24-h window.

parameters.label: Czas, w którym światło przy powierzchni < 10⁻⁶ normy (≥15 000 Tg sadzy)
parameters.notes: '0.5 mo to 1 mo after impact, depending on the initial soot burden' (15,000-35,000 Tg). Value = lower end.

parameters.label: Próg światła dla fotosyntezy (proxy)
parameters.method: proxy definition used in bardeen2017 (euphotic-zone 1 % criterion)
parameters.notes: Rough proxy; real thresholds vary by organism.

parameters.label: Całkowity węgiel elementarny (sadza) w globalnej warstwie K-Pg
parameters.method: measured boundary-clay concentrations extrapolated globally (bardeen2017 citing Wolbach 1990); scaling: wolbach1985 0.021±0.006 g/cm² × 5.1e18 cm²
parameters.notes: 56 Gt = 15 Gt fine + 41 Gt coarse soot (Bardeen citing Wolbach 1990). Upper part of range is my scaling of the 1985 global areal density (≈107 Gt, 76-138 Gt for ±0.006 g/cm²); Wolbach 1985 states ~10 % of present biomass.

parameters.label: Początek wprowadzania sadzy z pożarów (założenie modelu)
parameters.locator: SI Text 'Soot Emission and Removal' (Fig. S1A); Materials and Methods ('injected over 24 h')
parameters.notes: Model assumption, not a measurement: fine soot placed near the tropopause, coarse soot at the surface, emitted hours 12-36; sharp rise in wet/dry deposition near hour 28.

parameters.label: Masa drobnej sadzy w stratosferze (scenariusz referencyjny)
parameters.method: model:bardeen2017 (inventory from Wolbach et al. 1990 as cited)
parameters.locator: bardeen2017: Introduction para 1, Materials and Methods, Results (Fig. 1-2); lyons2020: Abstract; kaiho2016: Results para 1
parameters.notes: Bardeen: up to 56,000 Tg elemental C in the K-Pg layer, of which 15,000 Tg fine soot (citing Wolbach et al. 1990, GSA SP 247 - not opened by me); simulations 750-35,000 Tg. Kaiho 2016: 500/1500/2600 Tg BC from oil-rich target. Lyons 2020: 0.75-2.5 Gt BC from crater target. Source (global wildfires vs target hydrocarbons) and amount contested; Robertson 2013 argues target soot far too small.

parameters.label: Początkowa głębokość optyczna sadzy (500 nm), scenariusz 35 000 Tg
parameters.locator: Results 'Lifetime of Soot, Optical Depth, and Sunlight at the Surface', Fig. 1B
parameters.notes: ≈700 for 35,000 Tg soot-only; ≈500 with water injection; ≈10 maximum for 750 Tg. OD stays >10 for 2 yr in the 35,000 Tg case.

parameters.label: Wymuszenie radiacyjne aerozoli siarczanowych względem erupcji Pinatubo
parameters.notes: For at least 2 yr; forcing saturates between ~30 and ~300 Gt stratospheric S (higher loads lengthen duration). Assumes SO2 → sulfate in stratosphere; contested by ohno2014 (SO3, rapid rain-out within days).

parameters.label: Masa siarki wyrzuconej do atmosfery (scenariusz referencyjny modeli klimatu)
parameters.locator: artemieva2017: Abstract; rodiouchkina2025: Abstract, Table 1, Results and discussion; pierazzo1998: Abstract
parameters.notes: 325 ± 130 Gt S (3D hydrocode, ~60° obliquity, gases >25 km; used by tabor2020 and senel2023). Empirical S-isotope estimate 67 ± 39 Gt (2SD) is ~5x lower (rodiouchkina2025). Pierazzo 1998: 40-560 Gt over 10-30 km impactors; 76-127 Gt with 50 % recombination (as tabulated in rodiouchkina2025 Table 1). gulick2019 quotes '325 ± 60 Gt' - inconsistent with the primary abstract (±130). Range = 2SD low of empirical (28) to Pierazzo max (560).

parameters.label: Masa siarki — estymacja empiryczna z izotopów S w warstwie K-Pg
parameters.method: measured S + δ34S at 5 terrestrial K-Pg sites, global isotope-dilution inversion (rodiouchkina2025)
parameters.locator: Abstract; Results and discussion (site values); Fig. 4
parameters.notes: Average of Tanis 58±9, Dogie Creek 48±14, Brownie Butte 104±13, Knudsen's Coulee 71±11, Knudsen's Farm 57±5 Gt S (2SD); Brazos excluded (large uncertainty). Possible underestimate if microbial reduction removed sulfate; agrees with 1990s model ranges (Chen 90, Pope 35-210, Ivanov 6-106, Pierazzo 76-127 Gt).

parameters.label: Maksymalny spadek temperatury powierzchni morza w Brazos po uderzeniu
parameters.notes: Average SST up to 2 °C lower, two drops up to 7 °C below pre-impact; timescale months-decades (beyond 24 h).

parameters.label: Ekspozycja cieplna wywołująca oparzenia III stopnia (1 Mt)
parameters.notes: Wartość dla wybuchu 1 Mt; skalowanie do energii uderzenia: × E_Mt^(1/6) (eq. 39). Dotyczy promieniowania kuli ognia w zasięgu horyzontu — nie impulsu IR od ejecta. Synteza: Strefa skutków impulsu cieplnego kuli ognia dla odsłoniętych zwierząt (warstwa biosfery).

parameters.label: Prędkość przepływów tsunami przy wybrzeżach na całym świecie (dolna granica)
parameters.notes: 'Exceeded 20 cm/s along shorelines worldwide', also in the Central American Seaway; capable of scouring seafloor >10,000 km away. Tsunami up to 30,000x the energy of the 2004 Indian Ocean event.

parameters.label: Ekspozycja cieplna zapalająca drzewa liściaste (1 Mt)
parameters.notes: Wartość dla wybuchu 1 Mt; skalowanie do energii uderzenia: × E_Mt^(1/6) (eq. 39). Dotyczy promieniowania kuli ognia w zasięgu horyzontu — nie impulsu IR od ejecta. Synteza: Uzupełnienie progów zapłonu (warstwa biosfery).

parameters.label: Udział gatunków, które wymarły na granicy K-Pg
parameters.notes: Context only (outcome over millennia, not 24 h).

parameters.label: Ekspozycja cieplna zapalająca trawę (1 Mt)
parameters.notes: Wartość dla wybuchu 1 Mt; skalowanie do energii uderzenia: × E_Mt^(1/6) (eq. 39). Dotyczy promieniowania kuli ognia w zasięgu horyzontu — nie impulsu IR od ejecta. Promień wynikowy to kontrola krzyżowa dla fires.ignition_radius_fireball (inna metoda, inne źródła). Synteza: Strefa zapłonu roślinności od kuli ognia liczona z EIEP — porównanie z wartością z literatury.

parameters.label: Odsetek ryb jesiotrokształtnych w Tanis ze sferulami w wyrostkach skrzelowych
parameters.method: field/lab observation (depalma2019); synchrotron confirmation for a specimen (during2022)
parameters.notes: 'more than 50 %' (lower bound). Spherules only in gill rakers → fish alive and feeding during spherule fall and seiche arrival (During 2022).

parameters.label: Początek docierania kwarcu szokowego nad Tanis
parameters.notes: Launch angles 70-79° from the warm fireball.

parameters.label: Początek opadu sferul w Tanis
parameters.method: ballistic trajectories (depalma2019, recalculated from Brownie Butte work)
parameters.notes: ~15 min for 45-50° launch; 13-25 min for curtain spherules launched at 30-60° (top of atmosphere above Tanis).

parameters.label: Zakończenie głównego opadu sferul w Tanis
parameters.notes: 'The vast majority would have fallen at Tanis within 1 to 2 h of impact.'

parameters.label: Wiatr, przy którym powalonych zostaje ok. 30% drzew
parameters.notes: Próg empiryczny z prób jądrowych (las iglasty/liściasty); dla Chicxulub to ekstrapolacja daleko poza kalibrację. Wiatr z EIEP jest górną granicą — EIEP zawyża nadciśnienie dla E > 10⁴ Mt (airblast.overestimate_factor_large); dolna granica strefy liczona z nadciśnienia podzielonego przez ten czynnik. Synteza: Próg zniszczeń potrzebny do warstwy biosfery (strefy powalonych lasów); z wątku 07, tabela progów EIEP.

parameters.label: Wiatr, przy którym powalonych zostaje do 90% drzew (reszta ogołocona)
parameters.notes: Próg empiryczny z prób jądrowych (las iglasty/liściasty); dla Chicxulub to ekstrapolacja daleko poza kalibrację. Wiatr z EIEP jest górną granicą — EIEP zawyża nadciśnienie dla E > 10⁴ Mt (airblast.overestimate_factor_large); dolna granica strefy liczona z nadciśnienia podzielonego przez ten czynnik. Synteza: Jak wyżej — strefa niemal całkowitego powalenia lasów.

parameters.label: Miąższość stopu w rowie pierścieniowym przy pierścieniu
parameters.locator: Christeson2021 abstract ('~500-m thick layer of melt rock in the annular trough near the peak ring that thins toward the crater rim')

parameters.label: Promień pierścienia cenotów (ekspresja powierzchniowa)
parameters.locator: Pope1996 abstract ('approximately 83-km-radius trough or moat containing sinkholes (the Cenote ring)'); Hildebrand1995 abstract (cenotes coincide with peripheral gravity-gradient maxima)
parameters.notes: Present-day surface expression; Pope et al. interpret the moat as the outer edge of the crater floor (major ring fault). Pope 1996 also lists troughs at ~41 and ~62 km radius (peak ring = low ridge between them), an outer trough at ~103 km and a ridge crest at ~129 km radius.

parameters.label: Maks. wysokość wypiętrzenia centralnego ponad pierwotną powierzchnię
parameters.method: model:riller2018/morgan2016 (iSALE-2D, 200 m cells) and collins2020 (iSALE-3D, 500 m cells) - read from figures
parameters.locator: Riller2018 Fig. 2c (T=184 s, uplift crest at/above the +20 km frame edge near the axis); Morgan2016 Fig. 1C (T=3 min, uplift to ~+15-20 km); Collins2020 Fig. 2c (T=180 s, crest ~+10 km); Gulick2013 abstract ('rebounding crust rose kilometers above the surface')
parameters.notes: Strongly model-dependent (resolution, acoustic-fluidization parameters, impact angle). The thin spikes at the axis in the 2D model are likely axis/numerical artefacts. Not a measured quantity.

parameters.label: Suewit warstwowany (sejsze)
parameters.locator: Kaskes2022 'Bedded Suevite Unit (620.88-617.33 mbsf)'; Gulick2019 Results (627-617.34 mbsf: ~25 normally graded beds attributed to seiches)
parameters.notes: Different schemes: Kaskes 3.5 m bedded unit vs Gulick ~9.7 m interval with ~25 graded beds.

parameters.label: Suewit z gradacją frakcjonalną (resurge)
parameters.locator: Kaskes2022 'Graded Suevite Unit (710.01-620.88 mbsf)'; Gulick2019 abstract ('80-m-thick fining-upward, sorted suevite'), Significance ('another 90 m of breccia')

parameters.label: Miąższość osadów dnia 1 na pierścieniu (M0077A)
parameters.locator: Gulick2019 abstract (~130 m impact melt rock and suevite deposited the first day); Kring2020 ('130 m of impact melt rock and impact melt-bearing breccias'); Riller2018 ('130 m of impact melt rock and suevite'); Morgan2016 (~130 m)
parameters.notes: 617.33-747.02 mbsf = 129.69 m (top of Unit 2 to top of Unit 4). Deposition time is interpretive (minutes to <1 day).

parameters.label: Miąższość stopu i brekcji stopu (Units 3+2C) na M0077A
parameters.locator: Gulick2019 ('40+-m-thick impact melt rock, melt rock breccia, and suevite of Units 3 and 2C (706 to 747 mbsf)'); Schulte2021 abstract and Results (46.37 m: 3B 21.61 m, 3A 16.39 m, 2C-2 5.65 m, 2C-1 2.72 m)
parameters.notes: Thickness depends on where the unit boundaries are drawn; Schulte's 46.37 m sum is not consistent with a 747.02 mbsf base unless 3B extends below it (unresolved).

parameters.label: Suewit niewarstwowany (hialoklastytowy)
Warstwa przelania resurge przez pierścień (698-706 mbsf)
parameters.method: measured (core; interpretation as resurge cresting the peak ring)
parameters.locator: Gulick2019 abstract ('Within an hour, resurge crested the peak ring, depositing a 10-m-thick layer'); Results (698.00-706.00 mbsf)
parameters.notes: Interval is 8 m in the core depths quoted; abstract says ~10 m.

parameters.label: Średnia miąższość warstwy resurge w całym kraterze (sejsmika)
parameters.method: seismic velocity mapping calibrated by M0077
parameters.locator: Christeson2021 abstract ('graded suevite layer has an average thickness of 187 ± 58 m with only local thickness differences within the annular trough, peak ring, and central basin')
parameters.notes: Range = mean ± 1 sd as published. Implies the resurge carried debris across the whole peak ring.

parameters.label: Warstwa tsunami (przekątne warstwowanie, biomarkery lądowe)
parameters.locator: Gulick2019 Results ('interval from 617.34 to 617.44 mbsf ... 10-cm-thick unidirectional cross-bedded deposit'); abstract
parameters.notes: Overlain within ~4 cm by a charcoal-rich layer in basal Unit 1G.

parameters.label: Średnica końcowa krateru (krawędź)
parameters.method: measured (gravity gradients, cenote ring, seismic reflection) + interpretation of which ring is 'the rim'
parameters.locator: Morgan2016 main text ('~200-km diameter'); Gulick2019 Introduction ('~200-km-diameter'); Morgan2022 abstract ('approximately 200-kilometre-wide'); Hildebrand1995 abstract ('~180 km'); Kring1995 abstract ('~180 km'); Schmieder&Kring2020 Table 1 row 72 (180 km); Kring2020 abstract ('~180-km-diameter ... peak-ring crater')
parameters.notes: Spread 180-200 km is largely definitional (which ring fault / gravity-gradient maximum is called the rim). 180 km = horizontal-gravity-gradient maxima + cenote ring (Hildebrand 1995). Expedition-364 literature uses ~200 km. Larger values (240-300 km) refer to outer rings of a multi-ring basin, see crater.outer_ring_diameter. Synteza: Pomiar nie jest sporny — różnica 180 vs 200 km wynika z definicji krawędzi (maksima gradientu grawitacji i pierścień cenotów vs uskoki pierścieniowe). Przyjęto ~200 km za literaturą Exp. 364 (Morgan 2016, Gulick 2019, Morgan 2022), z której pochodzi kinematyka krateru w symulacji; 180 km w starszych pracach i bazach danych.

parameters.label: Głębokość dna krateru (rekonstrukcja, dzień 1)
parameters.locator: Gulick2019 'Postimpact Resurge...' section ('The 600- to 1,000-m-deep Chicxulub crater floor')
parameters.notes: Reference level not stated explicitly (interpreted as depth below the surrounding pre-impact sea floor/sea level); value is the midpoint of the stated range.

parameters.label: Promień wewnętrznej krawędzi (inner rim)
parameters.locator: Gulick2013 abstract ('inner rim at 70-85 km radius')
parameters.notes: Value is the midpoint of the published 70-85 km range (azimuthal variation); terrace-zone slump blocks step down from this inner rim into the annular trough.

parameters.label: Przesunięcie centrum wypiętrzenia płaszcza (na NNE)
parameters.locator: Collins2020 Results ('ca. 10 km to the north-northeast', 21.38°N, 89.52°W); Supplementary Fig. 1 caption ('offset 9.3 km NNE')

parameters.label: Udział objętości stopu w basenie centralnym
parameters.locator: Christeson2021 abstract ('~70%-75% of the melt rock volume is in the central basin')
parameters.notes: Remainder: thin intermittent melt on the peak ring and a ~500 m layer in the annular trough near the peak ring thinning toward the rim.

parameters.label: Średnica soczewki stopu w basenie centralnym
parameters.method: seismic imaging (Barton et al. 2010) as cited
parameters.locator: Schulte2021 ('lens within the interior of the peak ring ... ~65 km in diameter')
parameters.notes: Lies inside the peak ring.

parameters.label: Miąższość koherentnej pokrywy stopu w basenie centralnym
parameters.locator: Gulick2013 abstract ('coherent <3 km thick melt sheet within the central basin'); Schulte2021 (lens '2.2-4.4 km thick', citing Barton et al. 2010); Kring2020 Introduction ('~3-km-thick cooling impact melt sheet'); Christeson2021 abstract ('>500 m' in central basin); Kring1995 abstract ('~3 to 7 km thick melt sheet and breccia sequence')
parameters.notes: Christeson's >500 m is a lower bound; Kring 1995's 3-7 km includes breccia.

parameters.label: Objętość stopu impaktowego
parameters.method: scaling (Grieve & Cintala 1992) + seismic imaging (Barton et al. 2010), as cited
parameters.locator: Schulte2021 'The Chicxulub impact structure' section ('estimated at ~1×10^4 km³ (Grieve and Cintala 1992; Barton et al. 2010)')
parameters.notes: Order-of-magnitude only; primary sources not opened (see openQuestions).

parameters.label: Prędkość impaktora w modelu referencyjnym
parameters.locator: Riller2018 Methods; Collins2020 Methods (12 and 20 km/s); rae2019data (15 km/s)
parameters.notes: 12 km/s was chosen partly for computational expediency (Collins 2020).

parameters.label: Średnica impaktora w modelu referencyjnym (Morgan 2016 / Riller 2018)
parameters.method: model input:riller2018 (iSALE-2D, vertical); alternatives collins2020, rae2019data
parameters.locator: Riller2018 Methods (diameter 14 km, 12 km/s, 2650 kg/m³, 200 m cells, 600 s); Collins2020 Fig. 2-3 captions & Suppl. Table 1 (16-21 km at 12 km/s; 12-16 km at 20 km/s); rae2019data asteroid.inp (12 km at 15 km/s); Gulick2019 Fig. 2A ('12-km-sized impactor')
parameters.notes: Needed to know which snapshot set the keyframes come from; impactor parameters belong to thread 01.

parameters.label: Średnica zewnętrznego pierścienia (basen wielopierścieniowy)
parameters.locator: Kring2020 abstract ('~240-km multiring basin'); Pope1996 abstract ('eroded crater rim may extend to a diameter of approximately 260 km'); Sharpton1993 abstract (outer ring 'almost 300 kilometers in diameter')
parameters.notes: Outer ring(s) of the multi-ring basin; not the excavation crater. Sharpton 1993's ~300 km outer ring was argued against by Hildebrand 1995 (~180 km).

Opposing: schultz1996 from the SE (~135 deg, toward NW); morgan2006 possible uprange SE +/- 45 deg; Hildebrand et al. 1998 (LPSC abstract, not peer-reviewed; cited by collins2020) from the SW. gulick2008: pre-impact target heterogeneity strongly shapes the asymmetry, so azimuth inferred from structure is uncertain.
